# Requests replayed against the real Radarr to record golden responses, and
# against Unarr by the contract tests. Format: <name> <METHOD> <path> [body],
# where body names a JSON file under bodies/ sent as application/json.
# Names starting with "noauth" are sent without the X-Api-Key header, names
# starting with "session" with the cookie of a forms login.
# Requests run in this order on both sides, so a write is visible to the
# reads that follow it: writes belong at the end, after every read-only
# golden. Milestone 4a has none.

# system
system-status GET /api/v3/system/status
noauth-system-status GET /api/v3/system/status
apikey-query-system-status GET /api/v3/system/status?apikey=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

log-file-update GET /api/v3/log/file/update

# Milestone 4b. Provider writes: these change the fixture copy, so they come
# after every read-only golden. The mock indexers of scripts/mock-servarr.py
# answer on 127.0.0.1:18989 under /movies (movie feeds, categories 2000);
# /movies/empty has caps and no release, which is what a Prowlarr indexer
# without movies looks like; 18999 has nothing listening. The fixture's
# Indexers sequence stands at 19, so the two created indexers get ids 20 and
# 21; the download clients get 4 to 7.

# Grabs from the cache the searches above filled, each to a named mock
# client, then the queue they make and the history they leave; the delay
# lets the original's debounced refresh see the clients. The two queue
# reads after the first are the ones Unpackerr and Cleanuparr make on the
# maintainer's installation.

sleep 12

# Commands: the queue the UI and the scheduler drive. Each command runs in
# the background, so the sleeps let it finish before it is read back;
# `{id:name}` is the id the named response carried. The fixture's own
# clients (unreachable hosts) and the mock NZBGet are disabled first, so a
# usenet grab goes to the mock SABnzbd and a torrent to one of the two mock
# torrent clients. At this point Nightmare Alley is in the queue, Last
# Night in Soho's torrent is blocklisted and The Holdovers was grabbed and
# removed: the RSS sync has one release left to grab (Soho from usenet),
# the search for The Holdovers grabs it again (a search skips the history).
downloadclient-disable-others PUT /api/v3/downloadclient/bulk bodies/downloadclient-disable-others.json
command-rsssync POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-rsssync.json
sleep 12
command-rsssync-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-rsssync}
command-movies-search POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-movies-search.json
sleep 12
command-movies-search-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-movies-search}
command-movies-search-queued POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-movies-search-queued.json
sleep 12
command-movies-search-queued-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-movies-search-queued}
command-refresh-downloads POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-refresh-downloads.json
sleep 4
command-refresh-downloads-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-refresh-downloads}
command-missing-name POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-missing-name.json
command-unknown POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-unknown.json
command-series-search POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-series-search.json
command-get-missing GET /api/v3/command/999999
command-cancel-completed DELETE /api/v3/command/{id:command-rsssync}
command-cancel-missing DELETE /api/v3/command/999999
command-list GET /api/v3/command
queue-after-command GET /api/v3/queue?page=1&pageSize=20&sortKey=timeleft&sortDirection=ascending
queue-status-after-command GET /api/v3/queue/status
history-after-command GET /api/v3/history?page=1&pageSize=3&sortKey=date&sortDirection=descending&eventType=1
system-task-after GET /api/v3/system/task
health-after GET /api/v3/health
# A download the client reports as failed: the mock SABnzbd fails The
# Holdovers, the refresh records the failure, blocklists the release,
# removes the item and, "redownload failed" being on, searches the movie
# again, which grabs the next release the profile wants.
mock - POST /mock/sabnzbd/fail?id=SABnzbd_nzo_mock3
command-refresh-after-fail POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-refresh-downloads.json
sleep 12
history-after-fail GET /api/v3/history/movie?movieId=116
blocklist-after-fail GET /api/v3/blocklist/movie?movieId=116

sleep 12
